budget_scope: All selected training, validation and test photos across both tasks

litter.model_policy: Reuse the completed TACO-only L1 baseline; validate resized-input and mobile exports before deployment. Completed L2 is retained as historical evidence, excluded from this budgeted profile.

obstacle.model_policy: New compact run initialized from official pretrained weights; never resume the larger O1 run on different data.

constraints: Retain source split membership; select from labels and a seed, never model scores.
Litter and rock/log tasks remain separate because cross-task labels are incomplete.
Only three source validation photos contain rocks; per-class validation evidence remains weak.
Background means no labelled rock/log; it does not certify a clear trail.
No real blockage, erosion or exposed-root annotations are available.
Raw archives and earlier checkpoints are preserved; a smaller working set alone does not reclaim their disk space.
Only selected runtime models and metadata belong in the Android app.
